summary: Full backend + UI smoke of the new Enterprise SEO Center (10 tabs). 40/40 pytest cases pass against the preview backend. UI renders all 10 tabs, all 9 Overview KPIs, 5 overview filters; Global tab, Services table (12 testids), Audit run button, Indexing 'Not connected' banner, Cities expand (patna), city-service public page, legacy slug redirect, mobile layout — all verified working. GSC is correctly 'Not connected' with honest '—' for indexed counts (no fake numbers). Rejection paths (aggregateRating JSON-LD, unserved city /delhi, thin-content publish, redirect loop, external redirect, Disallow: /, root in private_paths, bulk noindex without confirm) all return 400 as specified. Sitemap index + child + robots.txt all 200 with expected content. Legacy /service/ac-gas-refill → /service/ac-gas-refill-home 301 works.

issues: Chart container warns 'width(-1) height(-1)' in console during initial render — cosmetic, charts render fine after animation.

critical_code_review_comments: Global SEO uses integer `version` for optimistic concurrency; page-level uses string `expected_updated_at` keyed off `seo_updated_at`. Review request mentioned 'old version' generically — current behaviour is correct (both reject stale saves with 409). Consider documenting the two mechanisms in the admin UI tooltip for clarity.
`/api/catalog/admin/services` is served under the `/catalog` prefix (not `/api/admin/services`). Not a bug, but worth noting so future tests / docs reference the right path.

Technical SEO page correctly flags the intentionally-seeded broken redirect `/old-ac → /services/ac-repair` as HIGH 'Redirect destinations resolve to real pages'. This is the expected per setup note; no action required.
test_credentials: Admin phone +919000000000, OTP 123456 (or 'Login as Admin' demo button). Loaded from /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Test created temporary bulk-edit title overrides and immediately cleared them via clear_overrides. Also created a /test-old-<ts> redirect and deleted it in the same test. No destructive side-effects remain.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_seo_center.py. Run with: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_seo_center.py -n 0 (xdist loadscope is forced globally; -n 0 ensures sequential execution so admin login tokens are not revoked by parallel re-logins). The intentionally broken seeded redirect /old-ac → /services/ac-repair will always show as a HIGH technical issue; do not treat as regression. Preferred host is empty, so canonicals use the 2b4c... preview base. Admin super-admin (+919000000000) bypasses RBAC. GSC genuinely not connected — 503/400 on submit-sitemap / sync / inspect is correct behaviour, not a bug.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found. Two initial test failures were test-side issues: (1) wrong field name `expected_updated_at` for Global SEO stale check (real field is integer `version`); (2) wrong path `/api/admin/services` (real path `/api/catalog/admin/services`). Both corrected and tests now pass.
